title: Governor, Reserve Bank of India meets Chairpersons and Managing Directors & Chief Executive Officers of select UCBs and Industry Representatives in Mumbai on November 23, 2026
summary: As part of the Reserve Bank of India's continued engagement with regulated entities, the Governor today met in Mumbai with the Chairpersons and Managing Directors & Chief Executive Officers (MDs & CEOs) of select Urban Cooperative Banks (UCBs) across different tiers. Representatives of the National Urban Cooperative Finance and Development Corporation Limited and the National Federation of Urban Co-operative Banks & Credit Societies Limited also participated.
